description: This file implements a Noma security guardrail for LiteLLM, integrating with Noma's AI-DR API to perform content moderation and safety checks on user messages and LLM responses. It defines classes for handling guardrail logic, including background checks, response anonymization, and verdict handling, with support for monitor mode and streaming responses.

classes.name: NomaBlockedMessage
classes.description: Custom exception raised when Noma guardrail blocks a message due to policy violations.

classes.name: NomaGuardrail
classes.description: Main class implementing the Noma security guardrail, handling API calls, response checks, anonymization, and verdict processing for LiteLLM.

methods.name: _is_result_true
methods.description: Checks if a result object has a 'result' field set to True.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the NomaGuardrail with configuration options, environment variables, and API client setup.

methods.name: _create_background_noma_check
methods.description: Creates a background task for Noma API calls without blocking main execution.

methods.name: _process_user_message_check
methods.description: Processes and checks user messages against Noma API for policy violations.

methods.name: _process_llm_response_check
methods.description: Processes and checks LLM responses against Noma API for policy violations.

methods.name: _determine_guardrail_status
methods.description: Determines guardrail status ('success', 'guardrail_intervened', 'guardrail_failed_to_respond') based on API response.

methods.name: _should_only_sensitive_data_failed
methods.description: Checks if only sensitive data detectors have result=true, indicating only PII/PCI issues.

methods.name: _extract_anonymized_content
methods.description: Extracts anonymized content from Noma API response for user or assistant messages.

methods.name: _should_anonymize
methods.description: Decides if content should be anonymized based on API response and configuration.

methods.name: _replace_user_message_content
methods.description: Replaces user message content in request data with anonymized version.

methods.name: _replace_llm_response_content
methods.description: Replaces LLM response content with anonymized version.

methods.name: _check_user_message_background
methods.description: Runs user message check in background for monitor mode.

methods.name: _check_llm_response_background
methods.description: Runs LLM response check in background for monitor mode.

methods.name: _handle_verdict_background
methods.description: Logs verdict (allowed/blocked) from Noma API in background, non-blocking.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook to check user message policy compliance before API call.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Moderation hook during API call to enforce policy.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook to check LLM response after generation.

methods.name: _call_noma_api
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous API call to Noma's AI-DR API with request payload.

methods.name: _check_verdict
methods.description: Checks API response's 'aggregatedScanResult' and raises exception if unsafe.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for NomaGuardrail.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Processes streaming response chunks, applies guardrail checks, and yields chunks.
